card.name: The word negative before inotropic
card.fires_on: The word "negative" when it begins a cardiac drug-effect phrase like "negative inotropic" or "negative chronotropic". Seen in drug interaction text about antiarrhythmics and beta blockers.

modes.label: Negative inotropic/chronotropic
modes.description: "negative" after "with", "potent" or "additive", just before inotropic or chronotropic.
modes.example: Disopyramide is a Type I antiarrhythmic drug with potent<< negative>> inotropic and chronotropic effects.

card.plain: It fires on the word "negative" when a drug is said to weaken heart contraction or slow heart rate.
